Generate a handle by Unicode-normalizing the title to ASCII, lowercasing it, replacing each run of non-alphanumeric characters with `-`, and trimming outer hyphens. Use `document` if nothing remains. If that handle exists, try `base-code`; if that also exists, try `base-code-2`, `base-code-3`, and so forth until unique.

Each record has `title`, `code`, `handle`, and `notes`. `link(code)` returns `https://archive.invalid/items/` followed by the code, or raises `KeyError`. `entries()` returns records in creation order. Inputs and outputs containing mutable data must be deeply copied, and caller mutation must not affect stored state.

import unittest

from solution import DocumentIndex


class DocumentIndexTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_entries_link_and_normalization(self):
        index = DocumentIndex()
        first = index.add('Café Déjà Vu!', 'DOC_1', {'tags': ['film']})
        second = index.add('Another Document', 'x-2')
        self.assertEqual(first, {
            'title': 'Café Déjà Vu!', 'code': 'DOC_1',
            'handle': 'cafe-deja-vu', 'notes': {'tags': ['film']}
        })
        self.assertEqual(second['handle'], 'another-document')
        self.assertEqual(index.link('DOC_1'), 'https://archive.invalid/items/DOC_1')
        self.assertEqual([entry['code'] for entry in index.entries()], ['DOC_1', 'x-2'])
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            index.link('missing')

    def test_empty_fallback_and_handle_collisions(self):
        index = DocumentIndex()
        self.assertEqual(index.add('!!!', 'A')['handle'], 'document')
        self.assertEqual(index.add('Document', 'B')['handle'], 'document-B')
        self.assertEqual(index.add('document', 'C')['handle'], 'document-C')
        self.assertEqual(index.add('DOCUMENT', 'C2')['handle'], 'document-C2')
        self.assertEqual(index.add('Document', 'B2')['handle'], 'document-B2')
        self.assertEqual(index.add('Document', 'B')['handle'], 'document-B-2')

    def test_code_uniqueness_and_validation(self):
        index = DocumentIndex()
        index.add('Valid', 'Abc_9-x')
        invalid = [
            ('', 'A', None), (1, 'A', None), ('Title', '', None),
            ('Title', 'with space', None), ('Title', 'é', None),
            ('Title', 'a/b', None), ('Title', 12, None),
            ('Title', 'NEW', []),
        ]
        for args in invalid:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    index.add(*args)
        with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
            index.add('Duplicate', 'Abc_9-x')

    def test_mutable_inputs_and_outputs_are_deep_copied(self):
        notes = {'nested': [{'value': 1}]}
        index = DocumentIndex()
        record = index.add('Title', 'CODE', notes)
        notes['nested'][0]['value'] = 2
        record['notes']['nested'].append({'value': 3})
        record['handle'] = 'changed'
        entries = index.entries()
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]['notes'], {'nested': [{'value': 1}]})
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]['handle'], 'title')
        entries[0]['notes']['nested'][0]['value'] = 9
        entries.clear()
        self.assertEqual(index.entries()[0]['notes'], {'nested': [{'value': 1}]})


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
